name: MCP library
description: A collection of shared MCP servers that expose factory capabilities such as flow analysis, wireframing, and visual-coherence scoring to agents.
shortDescription: Provides shared tools for factory agents
readme:
# MCP library

Shared MCP servers/tools the agents call — e.g. the wireframing flow-audit server and
the Figma sync server. One folder per server, each with its own README and run
instructions. Keep auth/config out of the repo; document where it's injected.
